case_number: 2024 INSC 894; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 3791-3793 OF 2011, AND OTHERS
summary: Land allotment policy to cooperative societies for MPs, MLAs, civil servants, journalists, and weaker sections; eligibility for basic-rate government land allocation; High Court quashed specific government memoranda directing land restoration and fresh allotment with transparency safeguards; preferential allocation challenged as violating Article 14 equality guarantee; Supreme Court upheld the policy framework but struck down category-based differential pricing as arbitrary; land restoration only for ineligible beneficiaries; mandatory public disclosure and affidavit-based eligibility verification upheld; penalty for false declarations confirmed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; High Court judgment modified to sustain allotment policy but invalidate differential pricing; transparency requirements upheld; ineligible allotments canceled; fresh allotment permitted under modified criteria.
